# Tenacity Tutoring

> Small-group Maths and English tutoring in Narwee, in Sydney's St George area (NSW, Australia), for students in Years 5 to 10. Year 11 classes start in 2027 and Year 12 in 2028. A family-run centre founded by brothers Tom and Josh Sowmi.

## Key facts

- Location: 16 Broadarrow Road, Narwee NSW 2209, Australia. Classes are held at the centre.
- Nearby suburbs: Beverly Hills, Riverwood, Peakhurst and Kingsgrove.
- Subjects: Mathematics and English.
- Year levels: Years 5 to 10 now. Year 11 from 2027 and Year 12 from 2028.
- Class size: at most 4 students per class, with a 2:1 student-to-tutor ratio.
- Sessions: 1 hour, once a week, for Years 5 to 10. A student can book more than one session.
- Class hours: Monday to Thursday, 4pm to 8pm.
- First lesson: a free trial, with no commitment.
- Approach: there is no fixed program. Each session starts with the student's next school assessment, then current classwork, then the next topic, then gaps from earlier years.
- Feedback: parents are told what is working and what to focus on next, in plain English.

## Fees (Australian dollars)

- Years 5-6: $60 per hour.
- Years 7-10: $70 per hour.
- Sibling or second-hour discount: $10 off per hour.
- Year 11 Standard or Advanced (from 2027): $130 per 2-hour session.
- Year 11 Extension 1 (from 2027): $100 per 1.5-hour session.

## How to start

- Register online at https://www.tenacitytutoring.com/register and choose a class time. A tutor confirms the class before the first lesson.
- Ask a question at https://www.tenacitytutoring.com/contact, by phone on 0401 455 112, or by email at enquiries@tenacitytutoring.com.
